notes.title: Robothorium is now out on Steam and Switch!!!
notes.content:
Robothorium, our cyberpunk dungeon crawler with turn-based fights, is now complete and ready to get out of Early Access. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zepugcb30F0&t=2s

Two years ago, we have started the development of Robothorium. We had no idea where it would lead us.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025551/35f45a61a3b1f5e05fdd7b4cf45c2cd0611683d5.jpg[/img]

6 months after starting the development, we’ve decided to change the art direction. And it was a great decision!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025551/8e6f6cbd0d1c51797a213c48c1dbfe562976f3b5.jpg[/img]

We’ve released the game on June 7th 2018 in Early Access, and it wasn’t that easy! 

After 8 months of Early Access, tons of updates, the support of our great community on our Discord and the great work of our partner for the Chinese market, Whisper Interactive, we are more than happy about the development of Robothorium and we are ready to let it fly on its own. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/657090/Robothorium_Scifi_Dungeon_Crawler/

Thank you all for your commitment, we are glad to have you in our community!!! 

The Goblinz Team

notes.title: War Drums Free Update is Live!
notes.content:
Hello Farabel fans,

[img]http://farabel.com/_external_files/images/WarDrums.png[/img]

The very first Farabel update, [b]War Drums[/b], has been deployed! This update features bug-fixes, changes and new game modes!

New:
[list]
[*][b]Orcs are now a playable race![/b] (and it's very fun!)
[*][b]Classic Mode[/b]: Build your own army by purchasing units and war machines. Destroy your enemy as quickly as possible and with the least amount of casualties to become a hero! This game mode allows you to play through a series of different battles.
[*][b]Defence Mode[/b]: Build your own army by purchasing units. In Defence mode, you take on an endless army which is impossible to beat. Survive for as long as possible and kill as many enemies as you can to become a hero.
[*]Collect [b]Badges[/b] by completing the objectives for each different game mode.
[*]5 new Steam achievements
[/list]

[img]http://farabel.com/_external_files/images/Badges.png[/img]

Changes:
[list]
[*]The Sleep ability has been changed. It now has a cooldown of 3 turns, a maximum of 3 uses per battle and — perhaps most importantly — it now lasts 2 turns. Also, inflicting damage on a sleeping unit will no longer wake them. 
[/list]

[img]http://farabel.com/_external_files/images/WD_Screenshot_1.png[/img]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*]The death of an Imp used to make several Surprise Imps appear on the same hexagon. We’ve fixed that! 
[*]Killing an enemy with a counter attack would sometimes stuck the game.
[*]Some units would be unable to move or attack after waking from a spell-induced slumber. We’ve fixed that too! 
[*]Pushing a unit out of the battlefield would sometimes crash the game, but not anymore.
[/list]

[img]http://farabel.com/_external_files/images/WD_Screenshot_2.png[/img]

If you like Farabel, and if you want to see more content in the future, don't forget to [url=store.steampowered.com/app/364200/]write a Steam review[/url]!
Enjoy.

notes.title: New game modes Beta available!
notes.content:
We didn't waste our time at Frogames, the first [b]additional content[/b] is already available for beta testing on Steam!

[img]http://farabel.com/_external_files/images/ModesSS1.jpg[/img]

Additional content? What are we talking about? We are talking about 2 new game modes.

The first one is the [b]Classic Mode[/b]: set up your battle (difficulty, visibility, level of units ...), define your budget, and finally build your army by buying units and war machines. The Classic Mode also allows you to embark on a series of several battles, and that makes surviving units very important.

The second one is the [b]Death Mode[/b]: face an endless army against which you will not be able to win. Hold as long as you can and send as many enemies as possible into the grave!

With these 2 game modes come 2 new biomes that will offer more diversity to battles.

[img]http://farabel.com/_external_files/images/ModesSS2.jpg[/img]

But the great news is that these new game modes now allow you to [b]PLAY the ORCS[/b]! Trust me, it's a lot more fun than playing those arrogant and characterless humans!
You dreamed of piercing your enemies with a missile of a Goblin Ballista? To put them to sleep? Or crush them under rocks? It is now possible.

[img]http://farabel.com/_external_files/images/ModesSS3.jpg[/img]

The work on this new content is not yet finished.
You will help us a lot by playing the new content and by making your comments in the Steam forums of Farabel. Many decisions have not yet been taken, UI still requires love, new texts have not all been translated, and many things need more work, such as budgets or balancing.

This new content is now available in beta  in Steam (right click on the name of the game -> Properties -> BETAS TAB). And of course, it will be released for free.


Enjoy!

notes.title: So, what's next?
notes.content:
[b]Farabel[/b] was released yesterday, so, what's next?

[img]http://www.farabel.com/_external_files/images/w.png[/img]

We're already working on a couple of [b]additional game modes[/b] for [b]Farabel[/b]: a Sandbox/free mode and a Challenge mode, where you'll try to stay alive as much as possible against waves of enemies.

[img]http://www.farabel.com/_external_files/images/visuel8_twitter.png[/img]

We think the actual version [b]Farabel[/b]  deserve more replayability and doesn't offer enough possibilities for additional content updates. Those new game modes will [b]bring never ending fun to players[/b], and a lot of opportunities to [b]expand the content[/b].

This first major update will be free, and will be available [b]next November[/b] (2016). That leaves you all the time necessary to complete the Campaign.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Farabel is out! . . . . . . . 🗡😭⬢⬢⬢⬡⬡😈🏹
notes.content:
What if you can go back in time and prevent a war?

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/364200][img]http://www.farabel.com/_external_files/images/PubPA.png[/img][/url]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/364200 

[h1]Farabel is a turn based strategy game that starts out at the end[/h1]

[quote]Farabel is a turn-based strategy game where you start at the end of the story; but that’s not all. In Farabel, the whole gaming experience is turned upside-down. You start your adventure with a hero at maximum power. With each jump into the past, your character is left slightly weakened, as the game become more and more complex. Develop your cleverness, your strategic prowess, and your inventive capabilities in order to survive![/quote]

To win at Farabel, being powerful means nothing. You have to be clever! And you have to get more and more clever as you go.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/364200][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22635566/03f7b1c7cec8cef02eea1d2fa6182c29dee13458.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Farabel Reverses Turn-Based Battle Stories
notes.content: I do not really have the patience for turn-based strategy. I like listening to Adam talk about it in the RPS treehouse and then I pretend that our shared employment means his victories and experiences are basically mine. Farabel [official site] sounds interesting, though, because it adds a strange layer of time travelling into the mix and makes you play from the end of the game backwards, decreasing your stats the further back in time you go. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Farabel Steam achievements revealed!
notes.content:
If you like [b]Steam Achievements[/b], today is your lucky day! We will reveal the 49 Steam Achievements of [b]Farabel[/b] today.

[img]http://www.farabel.com/_external_files/images/achievements_petit.jpg[/img]

There are 3 types of Achievements in [b]Farabel[/b]:

[list]
[*]The Battle Achievement, with a silver shield icon, which can only be unlocked in specific battles.
[*]The Stars Achievement, with a Star icon, which unlocks bonus battles.
[*]The General Achievement, with a gold shield icon.
[/list]

The Achievements of [b]Farabel[/b] are used to measure the player’s progress (like First Blood), to offer additional challenges (like Accurate catapult) and to bring even more fun (like Frozone)!
Some will be easy to unlock, others will require more concentration. A handful of them will only be unlocked by the most persevering of you!

Here is the complete list of the 49 achievements of [b]Farabel[/b]:

[img]http://www.farabel.com/_external_files/images/achievements.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Turning back the hands of time in Farabel
notes.content:
[img]http://www.farabel.com/_external_files/images/Article1_Titre - 640.png[/img]

The most observant of you all have probably picked up on the baseline: [b]Farabel, the game that starts out at the end[/b]. And of course, you don't know what's going on!
Let me explain what this is about.

The 2 main characters of the game are Cendor, Lord of [b]Farabel[/b] that you incarnate in the game and his right hand, the High Priestess. Each of them possesses the power to manipulate time in their own way.
Cendor can make a character step backwards during a battle by making it give a small jump in time. It is tactically very useful. But for now, what really interests us is the power of the High Priestess who is capable of making her spirit and Cendor's travel into the past for days, weeks, and even months if she wishes!

Well, in theory.

[img]http://www.farabel.com/_external_files/images/trailer-preview.gif[/img]

The game begins at the end of a war between the men of [b]Farabel[/b], led by Cendor and the Orcs of the Black Mountains, commanded by the cruel AZUK.
At the end of the first battle, the High Priestess attempts to return into the past before the start of the war; the root of the conflict.
After years of idleness, the High Priestress's power has unfortunately turned rusty and her spell fails miserably. Instead of being transported before the start of the war, the two characters gave a small jump backwards and found themselves in the middle of a battle that they had already lived 2 days earlier! The second attempt by the High Priestess was not any more successful and the 2 characters went as far back as the beginning of the war, battle by battle.


[img]http://www.farabel.com/_external_files/images/Article1_OnlyOneBattle -640.png[/img]

But the High Priestess can only travel in time with the mind and conscience of the characters, not the body. With each jump into the past, the characters are left with a slightly weaker, less experienced and less well-equipped body.
Typically, every time you complete a level in a game, you get to improve your hero's features on the characters screen. In [b]Farabel[/b], it's the opposite: the hero drops levels and you choose what features to diminish.

[img]http://www.farabel.com/_external_files/images/Article1_PerteNiveau - 640.png[/img]

This is the core of the experience that [b]Farabel[/b] wants you live: be increasingly weak and fragile in a world that is still so dangerous. [b]Finish the game and reach level 1[/b]!


[url=http://www.farabel.com]farabel.com[/url].

notes.title: Farabel is now in Beta! 🎉
notes.content:
So what's new in this version? New logo, new art, 13 new battles and a lot more!

News
- New logo ! 
- 6 New pieces of art 
- New Campaign screen. Now, you can unlock Stars and challenge battle stats! 
- 13 new battles, available when the player unlock stars

Changes
- A cool Main Menu 
- A very cool Credits screen! 
- New hexs for Catapults and Ballistas 
- New stuff in the Victory sceen (Star, New stat and Priestress)

notes.title: Farabel Alpha 0.6 is out!
notes.content:
So what's new in this version?
New content, an Advisor, a new default ability for your units and a lot more!

New
- Your personnal Advisor, available at the beginning of each battle.
- If you lose a battle, the Advisor will give advice.
- 1 new battle.
- 4 new units (Son of Azuk, Skeleton Orc, Imp, Monster from Hell)
- 2 new enemy abilities
- 1 new ability (Rage) added to all allied units, available 1 time per battle and per unit.
- Credits Screen 
- New Move and Selection hexagons
- New model for Cendor

Changes
- Options screen improvements
- Character screen improvements
- new Tutorial
- Optional camera blur turned off by default
- Units Highlight removed
- Removed the number of remaining turns for unit effects

Bugs
- The Old God Boss special attack now properly ends


Things are going to get serious for us in about 1 month. Beta is coming!

notes.title: Farabel reached alpha 0.5!
notes.content:
[b]So, what's new in Farabel Alpha 0.5?[/b]

New content & graphics improvements!

New
- 4 new battles
- 9 new units: Orak, Orc Shaman, Orc War Chief, Mage, Elemental, Skulls Thrower, Mounted goblin, Troll and Engineer
- 5 new abilities: Back in Time, Invocation, Shamanic Heal, Nature Heal, Rock
- Extended story and new dialogs
- Units can now move/attack/use abilities in any order you wish
- Player can use Ballistas and Catapults

Changes
- graphics improvements
- Tactical advices are disabled until alpha 0.6
- Tutorial is disabled until alpha 0.6

Things are moving forward and [b]beta is expected for August[/b]. Stay tuned!
